components.text: Eve Wormhole Portals is the only blunt EVE reference. Portals spawn on their own, live a limited time, and have a jump / mass limit. Classes: Unstable, Standard, Massive. Nine colours are a signature, not CCP factions.$(br)$(br)⚠ Radar: bearing and rough range. Detector: class, colour, time, remaining uses. Shards drop on collapse. Radar recipes come earlier than the detector (mod description).
Frame Changer and Waystones are not wormholes. There is no New Eden, Jita, or CONCORD in this pack. A hole in the sky, not CCP canon.
